root_cause: blocked air intake filter
key_steps: stop and lock out the compressor
vent the receiver to zero
remove and inspect the intake filter
replace the filter element
restart and check the build-up time

required_safety.control: Vent the receiver and lines to zero pressure before servicing any pressurised component.

root_cause: relief valve stuck partly open from contamination
key_steps: lock out and depressurise the press
remove the relief valve cartridge
flush and clean the valve seat
inspect the poppet for scoring and replace if marked

required_safety.control: Depressurise the circuit and verify zero on the gauge before opening any line or fitting.
Never check for hydraulic leaks with hands; use cardboard, wear eye protection, and seek medical help for any injection injury.

root_cause: worn and loose drive belt

remove the belt guard

required_safety.control: Bring rotation to a full stop and lock out before reaching into the machine; no loose clothing or gloves near rotating parts.

root_cause: a part stuck in the cavity from the previous cycle
key_steps: stop the machine and lock out
never reach in while the platens can move
remove the stuck part with brass tools

reset and cycle slowly with mould protection on

required_safety.control: Keep hands out of the die, mould, belt nip or ram path; block moving parts mechanically before entering.

re-run a test cut
